nt2e81.title: Capricorn's Quarterly Feelings Review
nt2e81.caption: Capricorn really built a slide deck to say "every Sunday, same diner, you." Honestly? Approved. Which sign in your life would schedule a recurring date?

nt2e82.title: Virgo Runs the Sync
nt2e82.caption: "Quick sync?" means I miss you. "Circle back" means I need a minute. Virgo translated, finally. What's the most corporate thing you've ever texted a crush?

nt2e83.title: Gemini's All-Hands Apology
nt2e83.caption: Gemini looped in stakeholders (the best friend) and then took full ownership. Growth, presented in slides. Tag the friend who apologizes like a press release.

nt2e84.title: Libra Tables the Motion
nt2e84.caption: Libra tabled dinner, pushed the label to next quarter, then went first on feelings. A full arc in one meeting. Which sign takes longest to pick a restaurant?

nt2e85.title: Scorpio's Deep Dive
nt2e85.caption: Scorpio's deep dive starts at your childhood and ends at "I want to meet your best friend." Intense? Yes. Into it? Also yes. Who's your Scorpio?

nt2e86.title: Cancer and the Different Goodnight
nt2e86.caption: Cancer built an entire case file over a star instead of a moon. The answer was: they fell asleep. Be honest, how many exhibits have you made over one text?

nt2e87.title: Aries Texts First (Again)
nt2e87.caption: Aries presented three exhibits and the jury said send it. Waiting around was never the plan. Are you a text-first sign or a wait-and-see sign?

nt2e88.title: Aquarius's Planetarium Date
nt2e88.caption: Aquarius walked the group chat through why a dark room full of nebulas is peak romance. By exhibit C, the couch was crying. What's your nerdiest dream date?

nt2e89.title: Taurus and Our Place
nt2e89.caption: Three dates, same spot, same bread. Taurus calls it a routine. The friends call it cute. Do you have an "our place" yet?

nt2e90.title: Pisces at the Puppy Party
nt2e90.caption: Pisces cried at a puppy's birthday and had receipts: the tiny hat, the singing, and being called "my person." By the end, everyone was crying. Valid, right?

nt2e91.title: They Remembered Her Name
nt2e91.caption: Mentioned your sister once, three weeks ago. They asked about her new job by name. Taurus has never recovered. What's the smallest thing that won you over?

nt2e92.title: Take Your Time
nt2e92.caption: Libra holding two menus like a life decision, and the date just leans back: no rush. Some people are built different. Which sign needs this patience the most?

nt2e93.title: Home Safe?
nt2e93.caption: "home safe?" and then they actually wait up for the answer. Sagittarius pretends to be cool about it. Sagittarius is not cool about it. Who checks in on you?

nt2e94.title: Bragging Out Loud
nt2e94.caption: When their friends say "FINALLY" because they've heard all about you already. Virgo, blushing in real time. Tag someone who brags about the people they love.

nt2e95.title: Excited About Your Thing
nt2e95.caption: Aquarius shows off the rock collection and the date asks to see the sparkly one again. That's the whole review. What's your thing people should get excited about?
